general.description: 30P30N three-element high-lift airfoil (JAXA modified slat config F) on generated grids, SA-noft2, M 0.17, alpha 5.5 deg, Re 1.71e6 (stowed chord)

domain.notes: The BANC curves (inches, 18 in stowed chord) meshed by the multi-element generator; the levels refine cells_per_chord by 1.5. A wall spacing of 1.5e-5 chords gives y+ ~ 1, as on JAXA's L1.

freestream.notes: APC-IV/V 2D task (JAXA); 5.5 deg is the open-air angle equivalent to the wind tunnel's 7 deg.
